selection_rationale: Selected 'Logistic Regression' as the optimal model. It achieved the highest composite performance (Macro-F1: 0.9361, High-Risk Recall: 0.9357, Balanced Accuracy: 0.9347). Because the synthetic data generation process follows an underlying generalized linear structure, Logistic Regression provides superior generalization, interpretability, and execution speed without the step-function approximation errors of tree ensembles.
